query: 产品回收率 产品回收率 衡量企业在报告期内，因安全、健康等潜在风险而必须执行回收的受影响产品数量，占同期已售或已运送产品总数的百分比。 A. 数据透明度得分 (权重 50%) 2分：清晰披露了回收百分比，或明确声明本期“回收率为 0%”。 1分：仅定性描述有/无回收，未给出具体的百分比或产品基数。 0分：未披露任何回收相关数据。 B. 统计口径得分 (权重 50%) 2分：说明了计算口径（如涵盖的所有产品线）及回收原因（如技术缺陷、标签错误）。 1分：仅给出一个孤立的数字，无背景说明。 0分：无说明。 最终得分 = 0.5×A+0.5×B 产品召回率 召回百分比 产品召回数量 已售产品数量 已运送产品数量 零召回 未发生产品召回 安全原因召回 健康风险召回 缺陷产品召回 标签错误召回 product recall rate percentage of products recalled recalled units units sold units shipped zero recalls no product recalls safety-related recall health-related recall defective product recall mislabeling recall 报告期内是否定性说明发生或未发生产品召回？ 是否披露因安全、健康、技术缺陷或标签错误召回的产品占已售或已运送产品的百分比，或明确声明召回率为0%？ 召回数量、已售/已运送数量及计算公式是什么？ 召回原因和产品范围是什么？ 报告期与统计边界是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '产品回收率'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 报告期内是否定性说明发生或未发生产品召回？ 是否披露因安全、健康、技术缺陷或标签错误召回的产品占已售或已运送产品的百分比，或明确声明召回率为0%？ 召回数量、已售/已运送数量及计算公式是什么？ 召回原因和产品范围是什么？ 报告期与统计边界是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“本期无重大召回”无比例；仅有召回制度而无数量占比；循环经济产品回收再利用率；仅有客户退货率；区分：尽管指标名含“回收率”，定义实为安全/健康原因召回数量占比，不是循环经济回收利用率；召回程序看制度完备性；本指标看量化比率或0%声明。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

It is our responsibility to safeguard stakeholders' interests by producing quality and safe products. All of our factories in Mainland have been certified with ISO 9001 Quality Management System. The certifications are reviewed and updated regularly to bring the Group's operations up to a wellrecognised and professional standard. The management system covers sets of internal quality assurance procedures and the products recall mechanism, serving as the foundation of our daily operation and control over product safety hazards and risks, and achieving the goal of zero complaints and recall.

results.text: 針對無害廢物,集團依循 5R 的管理策略, 即 拒 絕 (Refuse) 、減 少 (Reduce) 、再 利 用 (Reuse) 、維修 (Repair) 和循環再造 (Recycle) , 盡量實現「零棄置」 的承諾。此外,我們會根 據《中華人民共和國固體廢物污染環境防治法》 中列出的《國家危險廢物名錄》 ,妥善儲存及 標籤危險廢棄物,當儲存到一定數量時,我 們會安排合資格的有害固體廢物處理公司進 行回收處理。年內,我們香港辦公室回收了 約五千公斤的廢紙,減少約二萬五千公斤溫 室氣體排放,約等於種植了六百棵樹。

During the year, the Group has received six complaints related to products, and the relevant factories have dealt with them in accordance with the existing complaint procedures and the complaints have been resolved. In the future, the Group will continue to improve and to resolve problems in a responsible manner in order to enhance our performance in terms of product and service quality.

results.section: GREEN OPERATIONS / 綠色營運
results.text: In the procurement process, the Group attaches great importance to the negative environmental impact of products and the environmental performance of our suppliers. Therefore, we are committed to implementing a green procurement strategy and offering the priority for considering the application of suppliers with ISO 14001 certification. The Group clearly sets out its requirements in the contracts. Suppliers must undertake and ensure that their production, sales, transportation and after-sales activities are in compliance with national environmental and occupational health and safety management requirements. Supplier assessment and project review are conducted on a semi-annual basis to review suppliers' commitment to environmental protection and their employment of environmentally friendly equipment and measures. Meanwhile, we strengthen our communication with suppliers and actively convey the Group's advocacy and support for green procurement.
